_comment: Local additions and patches layered on top of the pinned upstream base pack.
Authoring format: 'additionalSettings' is a nested object here; build.py serializes it
to the JSON-encoded string Obtainium's importer expects. Any key you omit falls back to
the source's default (Obtainium fills them in via appJSONCompatibilityModifiers on import).
Only id / url / author / name are strictly required.

apps.reason: Not present in any upstream pack. Prerequisite for several emulator/tuning apps that need elevated APIs without root.

additionalSettings.about: Run system APIs with adb/root privileges from normal apps. Required by several tuning and file-access tools.

apps.reason: Not present in any upstream pack. AYN Thor only - swaps which physical screen an app renders on.

additionalSettings.about: AYN Thor: choose which screen an app is displayed on.
additionalSettings._note_versionDetection: Tag is 'beta-v0.1' but versionName is '1.0'; leaving detection on would report a permanent phantom update.

apps.reason: Exists in RJNY's source but carries meta.excludeFromExport, so it is absent from BOTH generated packs. Re-added here for the Thor.

additionalSettings.about: AYN Thor system tweaks: JamesDSP system-wide audio DSP and display saturation, with a lower-screen companion panel.

apps.reason: Track-only entry for this repo, so Obtainium can notify you when your own pack changes. DISABLED (empty profiles) on purpose: Obtainium resolves track-only apps against GitHub RELEASES, and this pack is refreshed by CI commits, not releases. It would sit silently on 0.1.4 forever. Enable it only if you start cutting a release tag when dist/ changes.

additionalSettings.about: This config pack. Track-only: notifies on change, never installs.

overrides.reason: Upstream points at the pre-rename slug 'AurelioB/cluster-tune'. GitHub redirects it today, but redirects are not guaranteed to survive a future slug reuse.

GameNative ships an XR build alongside the normal one, and preferredApkIndex 0 was picking the XR variant. Joey's guide says take the APK without -xr. Matching the plain name rather than excluding the suffix, because the suffix is unstable: it has been '-xr' (v1.1.0), '-legacy-xr' (v1.1.1) and '-modern' (v1.0.0-prerelease). This anchored pattern keeps 'gamenative-v<version>.apk' and rejects any suffixed variant, including future ones.

ARMSX2 interleaves iOS-only releases with Android ones. As of 2026-08-02 the newest non-prerelease is 'ARMSX2 iOS 2.5.1', which ships only an .ipa - so Obtainium resolves it, finds no APK, and the app never updates. The Android build (2.6.6.2) is two releases down. filterReleaseTitlesByRegEx is an INCLUSION filter on the release title (falling back to the tag), so this keeps 'ARMSX2 <digit>...' and skips both 'ARMSX2 iOS ...' and 'ARMSX2 nightly ...'.

ARMSX2 splits its release by Android SDK level, not by arch (a11-sdk30 / a13-sdk33 / a15-sdk35 / legacy-sdk26), so Obtainium's autoApkFilterByArch cannot disambiguate and preferredApkIndex 0 lands on the Android 11 build. The Retroid Pocket Nova runs Android 13 on an armv9 QCS8550, so pin the a13/sdk33 armv8.2 build. Anchored on the suffix rather than the version so it survives upstream bumps; if ARMSX2 ever drops the a13 build the filter matches nothing and validate.py fails loudly, which is the outcome we want. Merges on top of the '*' armsx2-skip-ios-releases rule (build.py shallow-merges additionalSettings in overlay order). Thor and Odin 2 are left on index 0 until their Android versions are confirmed.

excludes.reason: Dual-screen melonDS fork - only meaningful on the Thor. Renamed MelonDualDS -> WatermelonDS upstream in v7.16.0; matched by package id, so the rename is a non-event.
